casual.scene: In an empty glass-art workshop at late afternoon, leaning lightly against a wide stone workbench while inspecting a cool finished amber glass bowl resting on the bench. Both hands spread naturally on separate edges of the bowl, fully in frame. Kiln glow in the distant background and warm side light, no live flame near skin.

Bare shoulders arms and legs, a narrow midriff gap; secure full chest and pelvis coverage, no armor.

casual.scene: At her empty street-food trailer on a rainy night, standing side-on with her face turned toward the viewer while presenting a small paper tray of grilled corn on one relaxed palm, the other hand open beside the counter.
